findings.summary: The status card renders attendance/verification statuses as plain bold text via a bespoke _status() switch instead of the shared MobileStatusPill, so 'حالة اليوم' and 'حالة التحقق' lose the semantic color coding used everywhere else in the app.
findings.fix: Render the status values with MobileStatusPill (e.g. MobileStatusPill(state.todayStatus ?? '')), mapping attendance keys (present/late/absent/flagged/pending) so they get the shared status palette; remove the duplicated _status() label switch or feed its keys into the pill.

findings.summary: The hero container uses borderRadius 24, inconsistent with the design system's card radius of 20 used by all shared cards (Card/MobileFilterBar/MetricCard).
findings.fix: Change BorderRadius.circular(24) to BorderRadius.circular(20) to match the established card radius.

findings.summary: The hero gradient blends primary with colorScheme.tertiary, but the design system's accent is 0xFF00A8D6 exposed as secondary; tertiary is an auto-derived fromSeed color that may not match the intended brand accent.
findings.fix: Use Theme.of(context).colorScheme.secondary as the gradient's second color to align with the defined brand accent, or confirm tertiary is intentional.

findings.summary: Body uses EdgeInsets.all(20) list padding while shared components and MetricGrid spacing use 10-15 scale; the 22/24 padding on the hero (line 78) and 18 on cards are ad-hoc rather than following a consistent spacing scale.
findings.fix: Normalize inner card/hero padding to the 18/20 scale used by MetricCard/_MessageCard (e.g. hero padding 20 to match list padding) for consistent rhythm.

findings.summary: The large decorative fingerprint icon and status rows convey state visually only; the status card 'الحالة' value is bold text with no semantic emphasis, and long error bodies in _MessageCard have no scroll/overflow handling.
findings.fix: Wrap the status value in MobileStatusPill (which carries color+text) so screen readers and low-vision users get semantic state, and keep the error message readable within the card.

findings.summary: The loading state uses a hardcoded SizedBox(height: 260) to vertically center the spinner, which is brittle across screen sizes and differs from a centered loading pattern.
findings.fix: Replace the fixed-height spacer with a layout-based centering (e.g. a ListView with a SizedBox sized to viewport or a Center inside a full-height container) so the spinner stays centered on all devices.
